planItem: 77.44.7.A — full responsive typography Inspector-to-Canvas/draft/public lifecycle across editable PARTIAL types
finding: The existing cross-type matrix covered nine desktop typography properties and six mobile responsive overrides. The remaining wrapping, overflow, word-spacing, indent, and text-shadow fields had representative breakpoint coverage but lacked the complete 44-type renderer lifecycle.
change: Extended tests/browser/editor-inspector-partial-types.test.js to run all 14 registered non-color typography properties across every one of the 44 editable PARTIAL types. Desktop values are checked through responsive.set/key, Canvas CSS, draft Page Model Save, public immutability, Editor reload, and separate Publish. Mobile overrides cover all 14 properties, draft Save/reload, separate Publish, per-property inheritance reset, Undo/Redo, reset Save, a second Publish, and preservation of desktop values.

reuseReview.solution: Reused the project Property Registry, existing typed controls/presets, responsive device preview, per-property reset buttons, command history, and the existing real-Chromium lifecycle fixture.
reuseReview.externalCodeOrDependency: None; the existing project implementation and test harness were suitable.

browser.desktopCoverage: All 44 editable PARTIAL types: fontSize=20px, fontWeight=600, lineHeight=1.75, textAlign=right, fontFamily=Georgia, fontStyle=italic, letterSpacing=1.5px, textTransform=uppercase, textDecoration=underline, textWrap=pretty, overflowWrap=break-word, wordSpacing=1.5px, textIndent=6px, textShadow=0 4px 16px #000a. Registry command/key routes, Canvas computed CSS, draft persistence, public snapshot immutability, Editor reload, and explicit Publish are asserted.
browser.mobileCoverage: All 44 editable PARTIAL types: fontSize=24px, fontWeight=700, lineHeight=1.4, textAlign=center, fontFamily=Arial, fontStyle=normal, letterSpacing=2px, textTransform=lowercase, textDecoration=none, textWrap=nowrap, overflowWrap=anywhere, wordSpacing=2px, textIndent=12px, textShadow=0 2px 8px #0006. The Page Model and mobile Canvas/public CSS are checked; draft Save does not publish; Editor reload retains all overrides; explicit Publish applies them; 14 individual resets restore desktop; Undo/Redo, reset Save without public mutation, the second Publish, and desktop CSS preservation are verified.
browser.observedTestExpectationCorrections: The expanded test initially exposed stale assertions: 1.4 line-height with 24px mobile font size computes to 33.6px; the explicit mobile font size correctly publishes as 24px; after resetting mobile font size to inherit, Undo restores 1.4 against 20px desktop (28px). Expectations were corrected to the observed CSS and the full final run passed; application behavior and coverage were not weakened.
